instruction: Can you set Chrome to automatically refresh all my open tabs every 5 minutes? I monitor several dashboards and news sites, and having them refresh automatically would save me a lot of time.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a built-in setting to automatically refresh all tabs at regular intervals. While individual pages might have their own refresh mechanisms and extensions can provide this functionality, Chrome's native settings do not include an auto-refresh feature for all tabs.
